snippet.title: Dome Keeper | Multiplayer Update Date Reveal | Available on April 13!
snippet.description:
Dome Keeper goes multiplayer on April 13th! This free update will be available on PC, Windows and Xbox Series S/X, to all players who own the base game.

Defend against waves of alien monsters in this unique roguelike action miner. Dig for resources, collect useful gadgets, and upgrade equipment to increase odds of survival – just hurry back before your dome is destroyed!

Play Now! https://rawfury.com/games/dome-keeper/
